safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 4-day history of dry, itchy skin, located mainly on the chest and back.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes rash on chest/arms/hands (and face spared) but does not include the Gold location of chest and back, nor clearly state 'mainly chest and back.'
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that symptoms are mainly on the chest and back (and instead documenting other locations) can mislead clinical reasoning about rash distribution and differentials (e.g., contact dermatitis, scabies, eczema pattern), potentially resulting in suboptimal initial management. However, it is unlikely by itself to cause major harm if the rash is reassessed/examined at follow-up.
